scenarios.name: Keep favorites personal and remove deleted content

when: As the second account, open the book and inspect the Favorite control and homepage, then favorite it and verify its homepage entry. As the first account, unfavorite the book; reload the second account and inspect its entry and pressed state. findings.explanation: Ordinary visible text and nickname were treated as strict unique locators; legitimate repeated copies fail. Hidden draft-title copies were counted despite visible-title requirement.

findings.validation: Scoped TypeScript check; 19 positive/negative browser contracts pending parent execution.
